$comment: Regression corpus for the lint-only nested-relation branch of the concurrency gate.
eslint-rules/concurrency-guard.test.js runs every case below through the ESTree rule.
The former ts-morph nested detector was retired because lint and the runtime guard
are the authoritative diagnostic and closure mechanisms; this corpus preserves the
retired detector's unique static regression cases without restoring duplicate logic.
`expected` lists the findings in source order; an empty list means no finding.
Add a case here when changing the nested lint detector's supported syntax.

cases.name: inline nested update through a non-gated parent
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: nested updateMany through a collection relation
cases.code: await tx.campaign.update({ where: { id }, data: { encounters: { updateMany: { where: {}, data: { round: 99 } } } } });

cases.name: array payload form of updateMany
cases.code: await tx.campaign.update({ where: { id }, data: { encounters: { updateMany: [{ where: {}, data: {} }, { where: {}, data: {} }] } } });

cases.name: relation envelope bound to a const
cases.code:
const statsWrite = { update: { currentHp: 0 } };
await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: statsWrite } });

cases.name: mutator value bound to a const
cases.code:
const patch = { currentHp: 0 };
await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: patch } } });

cases.name: whole argument object bound to a const
cases.code:
const args = { where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } };
await tx.character.update(args);

cases.name: whole argument object bound in a for initializer
two gated relations in one payload, reported in source order
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { classes: { updateMany: { where: {}, data: {} } }, spellSlots: { updateMany: { where: {}, data: {} } } } });

cases.name: gated relation nested under another nested write
cases.code: await tx.campaign.update({ where: { id }, data: { encounters: { update: { data: { participants: { updateMany: { where: {}, data: {} } } } } } } });

cases.name: singular relation on an unrelated parent model
cases.code: await tx.mapToken.update({ where: { id }, data: { encounterParticipant: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: mutation helpers are not exempt from the nested branch
cases.code: await raw.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp } } } });

cases.name: plain object literal that never reaches Prisma
cases.code: const handlers = { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } };

cases.name: non-Prisma method call: no where key
cases.code: await store.update({ data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: nested create is ordinary character creation
cases.code: await tx.character.create({ data: { stats: { create: { maxHp: 10 } } } });

cases.name: connecting a map token to a participant changes only the non-gated FK side
cases.code: await tx.mapToken.update({ where: { id }, data: { encounterParticipant: { connect: { id: pid } } } });

cases.name: relation name reaching no gated model
cases.code: await tx.campaign.update({ where: { id }, data: { members: { updateMany: { where: {}, data: {} } } } });

cases.name: scalar assignment on a same-named field
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: undefined } });

cases.name: relation envelope written as a shorthand property
cases.code:
const stats = { update: { currentHp: 0 } };
await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats } });

cases.name: mutator value written as a shorthand property
cases.code:
const update = { currentHp: 0 };
await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update } } });

cases.name: argument bound to a const with a satisfies annotation
cases.code:
const args = { where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } } satisfies Prisma.CharacterUpdateArgs;
await tx.character.update(args);

cases.name: argument passed inline with a satisfies annotation
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } } satisfies Prisma.CharacterUpdateArgs);

cases.name: relation envelope behind an as expression
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } as Prisma.CharacterUpdateInput });

cases.name: mutator value behind an as const
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } as const } } });

cases.name: gated relation name used as a scalar field on another model
cases.code: await tx.spell.update({ where: { id }, data: { classes: { update: { a: 1 } } } });

cases.name: non-Prisma receiver that does carry a where key
cases.code: await store.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver resolved through a one-hop const binding
cases.code:
const chars = tx.character;
await chars.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver alias declared after a closure that uses it
receiver alias behind a satisfies expression
cases.code:
const chars = tx.character satisfies typeof tx.character;
await chars.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver directly behind a non-null expression
cases.code: await tx.character!.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: array destructuring does not identify a Prisma model property
cases.code:
const [character] = clients;
await character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: destructured function parameter is not a const model alias
cases.code: const write = ({ character }) => character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: gated mutator whose value is not a payload
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: makePatch } } });

cases.name: receiver destructured from the client
cases.code:
const { character } = tx;
await character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver destructured under a rename
cases.code:
const { character: chars } = tx;
await chars.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver reached through nested object destructuring
cases.code:
const { db: { character } } = ctx;
await character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver destructured in a for-of binding
receiver destructured from a quoted property
cases.code:
const { 'character': chars } = tx;
await chars.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: receiver alias outside the nested parent-model set is ignored
cases.code:
const rows = tx.characterStats;
await rows.update({ where: { characterId: id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: model reached by computed member access
cases.code: await tx['character'].update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: mutator reached by computed member access
cases.code: await tx.character['update']({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: relation key written as a quoted string
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { 'stats': { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: array-form updateMany element bound to a const
cases.code:
const reset = { where: { id: classId }, data: { hitDiceUsed: 0 } };
await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { classes: { updateMany: [reset] } } });

cases.name: computed relation key names nothing static
cases.code: await tx.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { [key]: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: namespaced receiver spelled exactly like a Prisma call is reported
cases.code: await repository.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });

cases.name: deeply namespaced receiver spelled exactly like a Prisma call is reported
cases.code: await service.models.character.update({ where: { id }, data: { stats: { update: { currentHp: 0 } } } });
